subject: Differences in featurecounts assigned reads between version 1.4.3 and 1.5.0

messages.author: c81250d882e23656
messages.subject: Differences in featurecounts assigned reads between version 1.4.3 and 1.5.0
parts:
Hello -

I'm trying to understand some differences I'm seeing in my featureCounts results when I run version 1.4.3-p1 and 1.5.0-p2.

From v-1.4.3-p1:

Assigned        121943563
Unassigned_Ambiguity    4054405
Unassigned_MultiMapping 51501134
Unassigned_NoFeatures   9290024
Unassigned_Unmapped     27154026
Unassigned_MappingQuality       0
Unassigned_FragementLength      0
Unassigned_Chimera      0


From v-1.5.0:

Assigned        63751730
Unassigned_Ambiguity    1970937
Unassigned_MultiMapping 51501134
Unassigned_NoFeatures   69565325
Unassigned_Unmapped     27154026
Unassigned_MappingQuality       0
Unassigned_FragmentLength       0
Unassigned_Chimera      0
Unassigned_Secondary    0
Unassigned_Nonjunction  0
Unassigned_Duplicate    0

This is for PE data.  For both versions, I've used the following calling sequence:
featureCounts -a gencode.v19.annotation.gtf -o tcounts.txt -s 2 aligned_demoused.bam

Can you help me understand why I would be half as many assigned reads with the current version of the program?

Thanks much!

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: Differences in featurecounts assigned reads between version 1.4.3 and 1.5.0
parts:
Hi,

This is possibly due to a bug present in versions earlier than 1.4.6-p4. The bug caused reads (not read pairs) to be incorrectly counted when the input data are paired end and also stranded.

If you count read pairs (turn on the '-p' option), 1.4.3-p1 and 1.5.0 should give you very similar results. For paired end reads, you should count read pairs since it gives you more accurate counting results.

Sorry about this bug.

Wei
